questions.question: From prison, John the Baptist sent his disciples to ask Jesus a question. What did he want to know?

answers.text: If Jesus is the One who was to come
If Jesus will come to the prison
If Jesus will pray for him

questions.question: Jesus told John the Baptist's disciples to report that the dead are raised. True or false?
Jesus told the crowds that John the Baptist was a prophet and nothing more. True or false?
Jesus said that if the crowds were willing to accept it, John the Baptist was which prophet who was to come?
